Rashi on Berakhot 6a:10:1.hebrew: בקרב אלהים ישפוט - ואין בית דין קרוים אלהים אלא בג', בפ"ק דסנהדרין (דף ג ב):
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:10:1.english: In the midst of the judges He judges - And a court is called elohim only with three [judges], [as stated] in the first chapter of Sanhedrin (page 3b).

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:11:1.english: And the Lord listened - He waits for them there.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:13:1.hebrew: אשר אזכיר את שמי - אשר יזכר שמי על מצותי ודברי:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:13:1.english: Where I cause My Name to be mentioned - Where My Name is mentioned concerning My commandments and My words.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:13:2.english: I will come to you - This is in the singular.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:14:1.hebrew: מכתבן מלייהו - כדכתיב: ויכתב ספר זכרון לפניו (סיפא דקרא):
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:14:1.english: Their words are written - As it is written: "And a book of remembrance was written before Him" (the end of the verse).

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:16:1.hebrew: קדמה שכינה ואתיא - קודם שיהיו כל העשרה:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:16:1.english: The Divine Presence precedes and comes - Before all ten are [present].

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:16:2.english: Stands in the congregation of God - This implies from the outset.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:16:3.hebrew: עד דיתבי - כדכתיב: ישפוט, בשעת המשפט:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:16:3.english: Until they sit - As it is written: "He judges" — at the time of judgment.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:18:1.hebrew: עוז לעמו - ומנין שהתפילין עוז הם לישראל? דכתיב: וראו וגו' ויראו ממך:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:18:1.english: Strength to His people - And from where [is it derived] that tefillin are strength for Israel? As it is written: "And [all the peoples of the earth] shall see, etc., and they will fear you."

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:1:1.english: If only you had listened - It is an expression of waiting.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:1:2.hebrew: למצותי - בשביל מצותי אשר צויתי לגמול חסד:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:1:2.english: For the sake of My mitzvah - For the sake of My mitzvah that I commanded to perform acts of kindness.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:20:1.hebrew: מה כתיב בהו - בשלמא בתפילין דידן כתיב: שמע (דברים ו), והיה אם שמוע (שם יא), קדש לי כל בכור (שמות י״ג:ב׳), והיה כי יביאך (שם), פרשיות שנצטוו בהם לשום זכרון מצותיו של הקב"ה, אות וזכרון להם לישראל. אלא בדידיה, מאי כתיב בהו:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:20:1.english: What is written in them - Granted, in our phylacteries it is written: "Shema" (Deuteronomy 6), "Vehayah Im Shamoa" (ibid. 11), "Kadesh Li Kol Bekhor" (Exodus 13:2), and "Vehayah Ki Yevi'akha" (ibid.) — passages in which they were commanded, for the purpose of a remembrance of the commandments of the Holy One, Blessed be He, [as] a sign and a remembrance for them, for Israel. But in His [phylacteries], what is written in them?

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:21:1.hebrew: האמרת - לשון חשיבות ושבח, כמו: יתאמרו כל פועלי און (תהילים צ״ד:ד׳), ישתבחו:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:21:1.english: You have affirmed - An expression of distinction and praise, as in: "All workers of iniquity boast" (Psalms 94:4) — [meaning] they praise themselves.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:23:1.hebrew: בשאר בתי מאי - שהרי ארבעה בתים הם:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:23:1.english: In the rest of the compartments, what [is written] - For there are four compartments [in the phylactery of the head].

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:2:1.english: To see - All the demons that stand before him.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:3:1.hebrew: כי כסלא לאוגיא - כשורת חפירה המקפת האוגיא שעושין תחת הגפנים, כמו ששנינו (מ"ק דף ב): אין עושין אוגיות לגפנים, לאסוף שם מים להשקות הגפן. כסלא הוא תלם של מענה המקפת סביב סביב את תל האוגיא, והגפן נטוע בתל. ובריש נדרים (דף ו ב): הדין אוגיא להוי פאה:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:3:1.english: Like a furrow around a ditch - Like the row of digging that surrounds the ugya that they make beneath the grapevines — as we learned (Moed Katan 2a): "One may not make ugiyot for grapevines" — to collect water there to irrigate the grapevine. Kasla is the furrow of a plowed strip that encircles all around the mound of the ugya, and the grapevine is planted on the mound. And at the beginning of Nedarim (page 6b): "This ugya shall be pe'ah."

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:1.hebrew: האי דוחקא דהוי בכלה - פעמים שבני אדם יושבים רווחים ביום השבת, שבאין לשמוע דרשה, ודומה להם כיושבים דחוקים:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:1.english: This crowding that is at the kalla - There are times when people sit with ample room on the Sabbath day when they come to hear the discourse, and it seems to them as though they are sitting crowded.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:2.english: These knees that grow weary - Weary knees.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:3.hebrew: מאני דרבנן דבלו - בגדי התלמידים שבלים מהר, והם אינם בני מלאכה שיבלו בגדיהם:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:3.english: The clothes of the Rabbis that wear out - The clothes of the students, which wear out quickly, yet they are not laborers that their clothes should wear out.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:4.hebrew: מחופיא דידהו - באין המזיקים ויושבין אצלם ומתחככים בהם. חופיא לשון חופף ומפספס (שבת דף נ), פריי"ר בלע"ז:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:5:4.english: From friction with them - The demons come and sit beside them and rub against them. Chufya is in the sense of "rubs and separates" (Shabbat 50b), froier [to rub] in Old French.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:1.hebrew: שלייתא דשונרתא - שליית הולד של חתול נקבה:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:1.english: The afterbirth of a cat - The afterbirth of the offspring of a female cat.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:2.english: A firstborn - The firstborn of its mother.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:3.hebrew: בת בוכרתא - ואף אמה היתה בכורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:3.english: Daughter of a firstborn - And its mother was also a firstborn.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:4.hebrew: ולימלי עיניה מניה - ישים ממנה מעט בעיניו. כל לשון נתינה בעין קורהו בלשון גמרא לשון מלוי, לפי שבדבר מועט הוא מלא:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:4.english: And let him fill his eyes with it - He should place a little of it into his eyes. Any expression of placing [something] in the eye is called in the language of the Gemara an expression of "filling," because with [even] a small amount it is filled.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:5.hebrew: גובתא דפרזלא - קנה חלול של ברזל:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:5.english: An iron tube - A hollow tube of iron.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:6.english: And let him seal it - [He should seal] the tube.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:7.hebrew: בגושפנקא דפרזלא - בחותם של ברזל, דבמידי דצייר וחתים לית להו רשותא, כדאמרינן בכל הבשר בשחיטת חולין (דף קה ב):
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:6:7.english: With an iron seal - With a seal of iron, for over anything that is tied up and sealed, they have no authority, as we say in [the chapter] "Kol HaBasar" in [tractate] Shechitat Chullin (page 105b).

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:7:1.hebrew: במקום רנה - בבהכ"נ, ששם אומרים הצבור שירות ותשבחות בנעימת קול ערב:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:7:1.english: In a place of song - In the synagogue, where the congregation recites songs and praises in a sweet, melodious voice.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:8:1.english: In the congregation of God - In His house of assembly.

Rashi on Berakhot 6a:9:1.hebrew: ומנין לעשרה וכו' - עדה קרויה בעשרה, שנא': עד מתי לעדה הרעה הזאת (במדבר י״ד:כ״ז), יצאו כלב ויהושע:
Rashi on Berakhot 6a:9:1.english: And from where [is it derived] for ten, etc. - A congregation is called [such] with ten, as it is stated: "How long [shall I bear] with this evil congregation?" (Numbers 14:27) — Caleb and Joshua were excluded [leaving ten].

Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:14:1.hebrew: חד לא מכתבן מליה בספר הזכרונות - כלומר, עם אחרים; אבל בספר לבדו נכתבין, כדאמרינן: וכל מעשיך בספר נכתבין (אבות פרק ב), כ"ש מדה טובה:
Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:14:1.english: [For] one, his words are not written in the book of remembrance - That is to say, [they are not written] with others; but in a book by himself they are written, as we say: "And all your deeds are written in a book" (Avot, chapter 2) — all the more so [regarding] the good measure.

Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:19:1.hebrew: אלו תפילין שבראש - לפי שיש בהן רוב שם של שדי, שהשי"ן כתובה בקמט שבבתים והדלי"ת ברצועות. ותימא משבת פרק במה מדליקין (שבת דף כח ב), דקאמר מן המותר בפיך, ולא מפיק רצועות מתורת ה' בפיך. ועוד, דבפ' בתרא דמגילה (דף כו ב) קרי לרצועות תשמישי קדושה בעלמא. אלא י"ל: אלו תפילין שבראש, לפי שהן בגבהו של ראש ונראין, דשייך בהו וראו; אבל תפילין של יד מכוסין, דכתיב (שמות י״ג:ט׳) לך לאות על ידך, ולא לאחרים לאות:
Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:19:1.english: These are the phylacteries of the head - [This is] because they contain the majority of the name Shaddai, as the [letter] shin is formed in the crease of the compartments and the dalet in the straps. Yet this is difficult from [the passage in] Shabbat, chapter Bameh Madlikin (Shabbat 28b), which states [that phylacteries must be made] "from that which is permitted in your mouth," and it does not derive straps from "that the law of the Lord may be in your mouth." And furthermore, in the final chapter of Megillah (Megillah 26b), it calls the straps mere accessories of sanctity (tashmishei kedusha). Rather, one can say: [Rabbi Eliezer specifies,] "These are the phylacteries of the head," because they are at the height of the head and are visible, so [the verse] "and they shall see" applies to them; but the phylacteries of the arm are covered, as it is written (Exodus 13:9): "to you for a sign upon your hand" — to you for a sign, and not to others for a sign.

Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:20:1.hebrew: מי כעמך ישראל - זה שיסד הפייטן (ביום א' דפסח): טוטפת כלילו גדלי:
Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:20:1.english: Who is like Your people Israel - This is what the liturgical poet composed (on the first day of Pesach): "The frontlet of His crown [declares] my greatness."

Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:3:1.hebrew: כי כסלא לאוגיא - כעין תלמים המקיפין את הערוגה, כדאמרינן בריש נדרים (דף ו:): הדין אוגיא להוי פאה:
Tosafot on Berakhot 6a:3:1.english: Like a furrow around a garden bed - Like furrows that surround the garden bed, as we say at the beginning of Nedarim (folio 6b): "This garden bed (ugya) shall be pe'ah."
